name: CaseChildOrderPermutedByAxis
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "child-order-permuted-by-axis" (layout). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: CHILD ORDER that varies on one enum axis by a ROTATION (A,B,C -> B,C,A) — a permutation that is neither the identity nor a reversal
